# Static files are hard linked into public when possible.
hugo --cleanDestinationDir
samefile static/a.txt public/a.txt
samefile static/sub/b.txt public/sub/b.txt
grep 'a' public/a.txt

# Generated files take precedence over static files without modifying the source.
grep 'generated' public/robots.txt
! samefile static/robots.txt public/robots.txt
grep 'static robots' static/robots.txt

# Replaced source files get relinked.
cp static/b.txt static/a.txt
hugo --cleanDestinationDir
samefile static/a.txt public/a.txt
grep 'b' public/a.txt

# Read-only sources (e.g. from the module cache) are linked too.
rm public
chmod 444 static/b.txt
hugo --cleanDestinationDir
samefile static/b.txt public/b.txt

# Hard links are off by default.
replace hugo.toml 'hardlinks = true' 'hardlinks = false'
rm public
hugo --cleanDestinationDir
! samefile static/a.txt public/a.txt
grep 'b' public/a.txt

# Links left from an earlier build must not be written through.
replace hugo.toml 'hardlinks = false' 'hardlinks = true'
rm public
hugo
samefile content/p1/r.txt public/p1/r.txt
replace hugo.toml 'hardlinks = true' 'hardlinks = false'
hugo
! samefile content/p1/r.txt public/p1/r.txt
grep '^r$' content/p1/r.txt
grep '^r$' public/p1/r.txt

-- hugo.toml --
disableKinds = ["taxonomy", "term", "rss", "sitemap"]
enableRobotsTXT = true
[build]
hardlinks = true
-- static/a.txt --
a
-- static/b.txt --
b
-- static/sub/b.txt --
b
-- static/robots.txt --
static robots
-- layouts/robots.txt --
generated
-- layouts/home.html --
Home.
-- content/p1/index.md --
---
title: p1
---
-- content/p1/r.txt --
r
-- layouts/page.html --
{{ (.Resources.Get "r.txt").RelPermalink }}
